description: This Java class 'ProductPriceController' is a Spring MVC controller responsible for managing product pricing within the admin section of a sales management web application. It includes endpoints for viewing, paginating, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product prices, along with auxiliary methods for setting up the menu context.

classes.name: ProductPriceController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing product prices in the admin interface.

methods.name: getProductPrices
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display product pricing details for a specific product.

methods.name: pagePrices
methods.description: Processes POST requests to retrieve a paginated list of prices for a product, returning JSON.

methods.name: editProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the edit form for a specific product price.

methods.name: displayCreateProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the creation form for a new product price.

methods.name: saveProductPrice
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save or update a product price, with validation.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product price and returns JSON status.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items for the view.
